textes.Les cinq tourteaux sont posés 2, 2 et 1: The five torteaux are set 2, 2 and 1 as on the image; the azure roundel bears three fleurs-de-lis, two and one, reduced and spaced apart (settings cs and ce).
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : la de: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the Nasrid motto in Arabic letters isn't drawn.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend que l'écu : l'Ateli: The drawing shows only the shield: the Atelier draws neither the lozenge shape nor the royal crown
textes.L'aigle impériale est la figure de Sodac: The imperial eagle is Sodacan's figure, with the thunderbolt beneath the talons: the text read by the Atelier doesn't say "grasping a thunderbolt", it is part of the figure.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend pas le double tresc: The drawing leaves out the double tressure flory counter-flory around the lion of Scotland
textes.La croix est affinée (épaisseur 55 %) po: The cross is thinned (55% thickness) to follow the image; the arms of the shield alone, without supporters or crown.
textes.Le dessin compte seize compons (la sourc: The drawing has sixteen compons (the source doesn't give the number) and shows a towered castle
textes.Le saint Ferdinand garde ses couleurs pr: Saint Ferdinand keeps his own colours (flesh, azure, or, a throne or): the tincture stated after his name changes nothing. The lions and castles of the bordure are the Atelier's.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend pas ce que le lion: The drawing leaves out what the lion holds (a sword and a sheaf of seven arrows)
textes.Le dessin ne reprend que l'écu : l'Ateli: The drawing shows only the shield: the Atelier doesn't read the crest and helm (helm argent crowned or, plume of peacock feathers, mantling azure)
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : le pa: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the landscape (confluence of the Euphrates and Tigris, palm trees, Hakkari mountains) can't be drawn; the sword and spear in saltire are suggested by two swords.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : l'épé: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the sword and the lion couchant; the sceptre in saltire, the donkey couchant and the eight-pointed star sable in chief remain to be added.
textes.Le casque de Skanderbeg est posé en chef: The helmet of Skanderbeg is set in chief, reduced and raised above the eagle (in the arms it surmounts the shield); the Atelier's "Ajuster" settings move it as you wish.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : deux: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: only two spears; the commander's baton, the two sabres, the spearheads and the tassels remain to be added.
textes.Le trait du coupé est droit dans l'Ateli: The line of the per fess is straight in the Atelier; on the image, the lion emerges from the first wave
textes.Les châteaux d'Artois sont ceux de Casti: The castles of Artois are those of Castile, with three towers: the Atelier calls them "châteaux donjonnés"
textes.La traverse de l'image va de l'angle dex: The image's traverse runs from the dexter corner of the chief towards the base: the Atelier draws it as a bendlet, a narrow bend
textes.L'Atelier dessine ici son aigle éployée: The Atelier draws its one-headed displayed eagle here, entirely sable (its crown is given the same tincture); the escutcheon is larger than on the image.
textes.L'Atelier dessine l'ours passant, qui mo: The Atelier draws the bear passant, climbing along the broad bend, as on the image
textes.Le dessin ne reprend ni les yeux d'argen: The drawing leaves out the argent eyes (allumé), and the ring through the muzzle and the gules tongue (bouclé et langué)
textes.La source dit « à la croisette d'argent,: The source says "à la croisette d'argent, au franc-quartier senestre": the Atelier sets it in a sinister quarter of the tincture of the field
textes.Le dessin ne montre pas le double pannet: The drawing doesn't show the key's double ward
textes.Saint Fridolin est dessiné d'après les a: Saint Fridolin is drawn after the arms of the canton (nimbus, staff and book or); the "proper" of the blazon isn't rendered by the tincture.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : bélie: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: ram passant instead of salient; crown, hooves, horns and pizzle of the field to be set.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : l'our: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the bear has no gules claws; the V and R of the second aren't drawn.
textes.Le blasonnement ne dit pas l'attitude de: The blazon doesn't give the bear's attitude; on the image it stands erect: the Atelier calls it "ours rampant"
textes.La rivière se dessine en trois fasces on: The river is drawn as three bars wavy; the three stars "grouped at the fess point" are set 2 and 1
textes.Le blasonnement dit « à deux lions … pos: The blazon says "two lions … set along the line of the division": the Atelier sets one lion in each part
textes.Le dessin ne reprend pas la devise inscr: The drawing leaves out the motto written on the argent
textes.La croix d'argent du gueules est posée a: The argent cross on the gules is set in the sinister corner of the chief (it is "over all" in the Atelier); on the image, it is higher and thinner.
textes.L'aigle fédérale est la figure du Bundes: The federal eagle is Schwab's Bundesadler figure (public domain): beak and talons gules; the card's drawing is in an older style, with less elongated wings.
textes.Les deux vaches du Béarn sont dessinées: The two cows of Béarn are drawn one above the other ("passant in pale"); the crozier is set bendwise sinister under the mitre.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : les d: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the two eagles' heads respectant are two eagles; the lion and the leopard don't carry their cross; the orange escutcheon with the ark is a mount or (the orange and the ark are missing).
textes.Les étoiles « accolées en bande » longen: The stars "set bendwise" follow the line of the per bend: the Atelier calls them "posées en bande"; on the image, the line doesn't quite start from the corner of the chief
textes.La source ne dit pas l'émail de la colom: The source doesn't give the dove's tincture: the Atelier draws it argent; the branch is olive, green
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : seul: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: only the chequy of twenty-five pieces is drawn; the crown of five shields remains to be added.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : les n: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the nine hearts are ranged 3, 3 and 3 beside the three lions instead of slipping between them; the ram and the bear are the Atelier's figures (ram passant, bear rampant), without the image's details.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend ni l'épée haute ni: The drawing leaves out the raised sword and the scimitar held by the lion
textes.Le saint terrasse un dragon sur le dessi: The saint strikes down a dragon in the drawing (the blazon says a serpent) and his nimbus isn't gold: the Atelier doesn't colour the figure in several tinctures.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : la cr: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the patriarchal cross is drawn as a cross of Lorraine; the crown and the triple mount vert are missing.
textes.La croix est dessinée centrée, comme tou: The cross is drawn centred, like every cross in the Atelier; the Scandinavian cross, offset towards the hoist, isn't yet available.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : l'aig: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the eagle of Silesia has no anchor, the harpy of Rietberg is an eagle, the base with the hunting horn is missing, the crancelin isn't set bendwise.
textes.Le chevalier tient l'épée haute ; l'écu: The knight holds the sword raised; the shield azure with a patriarchal cross couped or on his left shoulder is drawn without its cross, and the azure harness isn't coloured.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend que l'écusson, que: The drawing shows only the escutcheon, which the crowned double-headed eagle or bears on its breast; the vert is narrower there than the azure
textes.L'aigle est dessinée avec ses couronnes: The eagle is drawn with open crowns, with no sceptre or orb in its talons; the escutcheon of Muscovy is set overall, at the eagle's heart.
textes.Les deux fleurs de lis sous les pattes d: The two fleurs-de-lis beneath the eagle's talons aren't drawn. The four firesteels are turned as on the image, two by two on either side of the cross.
textes.« Sur le pic central » : l'Atelier pose: "On the central peak": the Atelier sets the double cross (cross of Lorraine) above the triple mount
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : les b: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the bends sinister aren't wavy; the overall is reduced to a per pale azure and gules (Vasa and Bernadotte remain to be added).
textes.L'aigle de Moravie est couronnée d'or su: The eagle of Moravia is crowned or in the drawing; the eagle of Silesia is drawn crowned, without the crescent surmounted by a cross on its breast, which the Atelier doesn't yet draw.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : l'équ: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the equipollé (eight points sable, seven points argent) is suggested by a chequy of four rows.
textes.L'image montre quatre pièces : le dessin: The image shows four pieces: the drawing follows it, while the source says "burelé" (which implies more).
textes.Le dessin suit le blasonnement de l'écu: The drawing follows the blazon of the shield ("fourchée" for "fourchue"); the royal crown on the shield isn't drawn.
textes.L'Atelier dessine l'ours rampant, sans s: The Atelier draws the bear rampant, without its gules attributes
textes.L'Atelier ne dessine pas le collier à cr: The Atelier doesn't draw the collar with a cross
textes.Le chef et la rose sont dits en toutes l: The chief and the rose are spelled out ("of the first", "of the second": argent and gules)
textes.Le lien d'azur des clefs n'est pas dessi: The azure tie of the keys isn't drawn
textes.L'Atelier ne connaît pas le mot « aiglet: The Atelier doesn't know the word "aiglette": it says "aigle"
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : les c: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the hearts are a semé with no fixed count; the third quarter is reduced to the three crowns (the ram and the polar bear in base are missing).
textes.Le premier quartier est semé de cœurs sa: The first quarter is semé of hearts without counting nine; the ram and the bear are drawn without their gold claws and horns; the bear is drawn rampant, not erect.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : la br: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the thorn branch is a bend vert; the three bars argent are a barry of six.
textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : le br: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the armoured arm holding two olive branches and the sun with a face remain to be added; only one crescent or.
textes.Le dessin ne reprend pas la terrasse de: The drawing leaves out the terrace vert on which the column stands

textes.« Au naturel » : l'Atelier dessine le pi: "Proper": the Atelier draws the pine vert, without counting its three branches or five roots

textes.Ébauche à ajuster dans l'Atelier : la fl: Draft to adjust in the Atelier: the arrow in saltire, the star or, the eight roses of the bordure and the two anchors behind the shield are missing.
